ayahOccurrences.text: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَفِيفًا is in the derivative form: لَفِيف
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ف/ف   l–f–f (of the thighs) to be fleshy
; to gather together, to wrap up; large crowd of a mixture of people, thicket of trees; to stutter.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
اِلْتَفَّ ʾiltaffa; ألْفَاف ʾalfāf andلَفِيف lafıf.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
لَفِيف lafıf [quasi‐act./pass. part.] diversified crowd, a mixed group

(17:104) ‏فَإِذَا‏ ‏جَاءَ‏ ‏وَعْدُ‏ ‏الآخِرَةِ‏ ‏جِئْنَا‏ ‏بِكُمْ‏ ‏لَفِيفًا‏ and when the promise of the Hereafter is fulfilled, We shall bring you [out] as a mixed group.

entries.label: ألْفَاف
entries.definitionHtml:
ألْفَاف ʾalfāf [pl. of لُفّ luff which is, in turn, pl. of quasi‐act. part. لَفَّاء laffāʾ] intertwined, conflated, thickly interlacing, tangled

(78:15–16) لِنُخْرِجَ‏ ‏بِهِ‏ ‏حَبًّا‏ ‏وَنَبَاتًا وَجَنَّاتٍ‏ ‏أَلْفَافًا‏ to bring forth with it grain, plants and gardens of interlacing foliage.

entries.label: اِلْتَفَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
اِلْتَفَّ ʾiltaffa [v. VIII, intrans.] to wind around, to join closely together *

(75:29) وَالْتَفَّتِ‏ ‏السَّاقُ‏ ‏بِالسَّاقِ when death overtakes the person [lit. and leg is intertwined with leg].
